description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for handling catalog category endpoints, including listing categories and retrieving a category by ID, with accompanying URL mappings and response transformation logic.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: REST controller for catalog category operations, providing endpoints to list categories and retrieve category details.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list categories for a specific store with pagination.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific category by its ID.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Category domain object into a CategoryResponse DTO suitable for API response.
